tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List all catalogued i6eal Open AI Data datasets covering Germany and the EU, with bilingual titles, descriptions, operating states, observation start dates, distributions, upstream sources, and compilation-only rights scope. Optionally filter by keyword or operating state.

tools.name: get_dataset_overview
tools.description: Fetch live summary metadata, counts, temporal coverage, data state, upstream sources, available JSON/CSV/Atom distributions, and attribution guidance for one catalogued dataset without dumping large raw record arrays.

tools.name: get_dataset_methodology
tools.description: Fetch the official methodology.json document for a dataset, detailing collection rules, exact-identifier linkage rules, official sources, known exclusions, and what the dataset explicitly does not claim.

tools.name: query_dataset_records
tools.description: Search, filter, and paginate records from any catalogued dataset’s primary JSON record list or one of its sibling CSV distributions. Always returns bounded results with total counts, data state, attribution, and compilation-only rights notice.

tools.name: get_dataset_changes
tools.description: Fetch and parse the RFC 4287 Atom change feed for a dataset that tracks revisions over time, returning structured recent revision entries with timestamps, summaries, and links.

tools.name: get_dcat_catalogue
tools.description: Fetch the live machine-readable DCAT-AP JSON-LD catalogue (/data/catalog/dcat.jsonld). Optionally filter to a single dataset node to inspect its full RDF distributions, temporal intervals, and rights metadata.

tools.name: get_platform_automation_dossier
tools.description: Query the EU Platform Automation Monitor (derived from European Commission DSA Transparency Database monthly statements of reasons). Look up a specific online platform by name or slug, or list top platforms with automated detection vs. automated decision breakdowns. Preserves DSA boundaries: stateme

tools.name: get_enforcement_actions
tools.description: Filter verified official AI-related enforcement actions in Germany and the EU from the AI Enforcement Monitor, returning procedural status, authority, subject, legal basis, recorded amounts (distinguishing fines from other monetary measures), and primary-source evidence links.

tools.name: get_german_state_ai_dossier
tools.description: Retrieve one or all 16 German federal states (Bundesländer) from German State AI Evidence Layers, keeping its three evidence layers (public AI systems, procurement notices, telecommunications infrastructure) explicitly separate with independent observation timestamps and no composite ranking.

tools.name: search_across_datasets
tools.description: Search for an official identifier (such as ECLI, TED notice ID, EUCT number, or budget title number) or keyword across catalogued datasets, returning bounded matches grouped by dataset with source citations. Co-occurring text matches across datasets are never inferred links.
